title: Present tense: -er and -ir
explanation:
Comer uses -o, -es, -e, -emos, -éis, and -en: como, comes, come, comemos, coméis, comen. Vivir uses -o, -es, -e, -imos, -ís, and -en: vivo, vives, vive, vivimos, vivís, viven.

The yo form of both families ends in -o. The tú form of both ends in -es. The plural endings are the part that separates them.
commonMistake: Giving vivir an -ar ending, such as vivas, or putting the accent on the wrong letter in coméis and vivís.
